title: Polar station grid map and six map questions
subject: Geography
source: Written for geography/y6 lesson 8 (Polar station grid map and 6 map questions (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 8. A practice map of a coast in Antarctica. Each grid square is 2 km across. Read along (eastings) first, then up (northings).

blocks.caption: North is at the top. Our own practice map.

questions.q: Give the grid reference of the research station.
Give the two grid references for the mountains.
In which direction is the sea ice from the research station?
In which direction is the landing beach from the research station?
How far is it from the landing beach (0301) north to the glacier (0304)?
